title: Fix git status changed count double-counting
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `statusSummary` (src/core/git.ts:48-53) counts a `MM`-style porcelain line (staged + unstaged modifications) in BOTH the staged and unstaged buckets, so `changed = staged.length + unstaged.length` double-counts such files. Fix the `changed` aggregate to count distinct files.
acceptance: `changed` equals the number of distinct changed files (a single `MM` entry counts once).
A unit test covers the `MM`/`AM` double-status porcelain case.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
